limitations: Trained on English GoEmotions mapped to seven classes; conditions B and D also use EmoSen tweets (six classes, no Neutral).
The Hinglish test sets are small: HinEmo-9 gold has 270 examples in 5 classes (no disgust or neutral); EmoSen test has only 13 fear and 7 surprise examples.
Reported scores are means over 3 seeds. Differences between adapted and non-adapted models were not statistically reliable.
Probabilities are overconfident (expected calibration error up to about 0.21 on HinEmo-9) and have not been recalibrated.
Models adapted on EmoSen tend to predict disgust for angry tweets (an annotation-convention and class-weighting effect under investigation).
Labels are dataset annotation conventions, not a person's true feelings. Do not use the output to make decisions about people.
No sarcasm, sentiment or intent model is included in this prototype.
